cache_analysis._description: Results of slab cache merge analysis

merged_caches._description: Map from named cache name to the kmalloc cache it was merged into

standalone_caches._description: List of named caches that remain independent (not merged)

vulnerability_analysis._description: Array with one entry per vulnerability report

_items.vuln_id: string - derived from KASAN report filename without extension
_items.source_cache: string - the slab cache identified in the KASAN report
_items.effective_cache: string - the physical cache serving allocations (accounting for allocator merging)

reachable_targets._description: Kernel structures reachable through heap manipulation via this vulnerability, filtered to those with security-relevant fields in the controllable range

_items.target_cache: string - cache this structure is allocated from

controllable_region.offset_in_target: int - byte offset where attacker control begins within the target structure
controllable_region.size: int - number of bytes under attacker control in the target

controllable_fields._description: Security-relevant fields overlapping the controllable region, one entry per (field, capability) pair

_items.capability: string - security capability (e.g. code_exec, info_leak, arbitrary_rw, arbitrary_read, privilege_escalation)
_items.exploit_method: string - exploitation technique for this field
_items.mitigated: bool - whether an active mitigation neutralizes this capability
_items.mitigation_reason: string or null - mitigation name if mitigated, null otherwise
